text: Given a valid API key header, When neon_list_projects is called with no arguments, Then it returns the mocked project list (id/name/region/created_at) verbatim
Given cursor and limit arguments, When neon_list_projects is called, Then they are passed through as query params on GET /projects
Given a project, When neon_list_branches is called, Then each returned branch has id/name/parent_id/default/protected/state
Given a project, When neon_create_branch is called, Then it POSTs the branch body and returns the new branch id plus its tracking operation(s)
Given a project and branch, When neon_delete_branch is called without confirm:true, Then no call reaches Neon and the tool returns a confirmation-required error
Given a project and branch, When neon_delete_branch is called with confirm:true, Then Neon's DELETE endpoint is called and the tracking operation(s) are returned
Given a project, When neon_list_endpoints is called, Then each returned endpoint has id/branch_id/type/state
Given a project and branch, When neon_list_databases is called, Then each returned database has name and owner
Given a project and branch, When neon_create_database is called with a name and owner, Then it POSTs that body and returns the created record
Given a project and branch, When neon_list_roles is called, Then each returned role has a name and a protected flag

Given a project and branch, When neon_create_role is called and the mocked response includes a generated password, Then the password is returned once in the tool result and never appears in a log line
evidence: uv run pytest -v -> tests/test_tools.py::test_create_role_password_not_logged PASSED (.tdd/pytest_verbose.log line 39); asserts both result["password"] == "s3cret-pw" and "s3cret-pw" not in caplog.text

text: Given an existing project/branch/database/role, When neon_get_connection_uri is called, Then it returns the full connection URI
Given a database/role combination Neon reports as not found, When neon_get_connection_uri is called, Then it returns a structured not_found error, not a raw error
Given a project and an operation id, When neon_get_operation is called, Then it returns that operation's current status
Given a project, When neon_list_operations is called, Then it returns the project's recent operations
Given a request with no X-Neon-API-Key header, When any tool is called, Then the connector returns a structured 401 naming the required header and the mocked upstream records zero calls
evidence: uv run pytest -v -> tests/test_middleware.py::test_missing_api_key_header_returns_401[headers0/1/2] PASSED (.tdd/pytest_verbose.log lines 18-20); live smoke test confirmed the same: curl POST /mcp with no header -> HTTP 401 {"error":"Missing credentials","message":"Missing header: X-Neon-API-Key","required_headers":["X-Neon-API-Key"]}

text: Given a mocked 401/403 upstream response, When any tool is called, Then it is surfaced as a structured unauthorized error, not a stack trace
evidence: uv run pytest -v -> tests/test_api_client.py::test_401_403_mapped_to_unauthorized_envelope[401] and [403] PASSED (.tdd/pytest_verbose.log lines 11-12)

text: Given a mocked 404 upstream response (unknown project/branch/database/role id), When any tool is called, Then it is surfaced as a structured not_found error
Given a mocked 429 upstream response on a read tool, When the call is retried per the backoff policy and still fails, Then it surfaces a structured rate_limited error within the call budget
evidence: uv run pytest -v -> tests/test_api_client.py::test_429_retried_then_rate_limited_envelope PASSED (.tdd/pytest_verbose.log line 14); asserts exactly 3 GET attempts (1 + _MAX_RETRIES) then rate_limited/retryable=True

text: Given two concurrent requests carrying two different X-Neon-API-Key values, When each is handled, Then each only sees the mocked response wired to its own key and no module-level state is shared between them
evidence: uv run pytest -v -> tests/test_middleware.py::test_concurrent_requests_do_not_share_credentials PASSED (.tdd/pytest_verbose.log line 23); also test_shared_http_client_never_stores_or_sends_cookies PASSED confirms the shared httpx.AsyncClient rejects all cookies

text: Given a real free-tier Neon project, When projects/branches/endpoints/databases/roles are listed through the connector, Then the returned records match what the Neon Console shows (covers AC1, AC2, AC6, AC7, AC9)
steps: Configure a real Neon API key in the X-Neon-API-Key header
Call neon_list_projects, neon_list_branches, neon_list_endpoints, neon_list_databases, neon_list_roles against that project
Open the same project in the Neon Console
expect: Every id/name/state field returned by the tools matches the Neon Console's display for the same project
notes: needs a real vendor account; no Neon credentials are configured in this pipeline's environment (SOP: not a blocker). Left for post-release verification once a Neon account is available.

text: Given a real Neon project, When a branch is created, polled to completion, and deleted with confirm:true, Then both the create and the delete are reflected in the Neon Console (covers AC3, AC5, AC12)
steps: Call neon_create_branch on a real project
Poll neon_get_operation until status is terminal
Confirm the branch appears in the Neon Console
Confirm the branch disappears from the Neon Console
expect: Branch appears after create+operation-finished, disappears after the confirmed delete
notes: needs a real vendor account; no Neon credentials are configured in this pipeline's environment (SOP: not a blocker). Left for post-release verification once a Neon account is available.

text: Given a real project/branch/database/role, When neon_get_connection_uri is called and the returned URI is used to open a Postgres connection, Then the connection succeeds
steps: Call neon_get_connection_uri for a real project/branch/database/role
